title: List Wallets Request
description: Request to list the wallets belonging to the authenticated client, with balances in each wallet's native currency and an optional currency conversion.

conversion_currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code. When supplied, balance amounts are additionally returned converted to this currency.

start_date_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or epoch seconds. Lower bound of the `balance as of` window.

end_date_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or epoch seconds. Upper bound of the `balance as of` window.
